messages:
sasha (platform): quick proposal: split fncall/structured-output telemetry into two pipelines. keep 100% of strict rejects for forensics, sample the noisy soft failures. dashboards currently flood with soft noise.
li (eng-telemetry): sounds reasonable. can you enumerate the minimum payload for each stream? we need to estimate ingest cost.
sasha (platform): strict_rejects -> route_id, model_variant, schema_id, reject_reason, request_id, deploy_id, origin_tag, redaction_flag. soft_fails -> route_id, schema_id, score, snippet_hash, sample_marker. keep soft small (1-3%).
noah (product): from UX perspective we need a single view showing both trends + a way to inspect examples. examples must not reveal customer content unless redaction/opt-in.
maya (privacy): correct. any text included in telemetry must be redacted client-side. include a hash for correlation, redact PII and long payloads. we need an approved transform list before rollout.
li (eng-telemetry): implementation idea: two Kafka topics: fncall.rejects.strict (no sampler) and fncall.fails.soft.sampled (sampler). emit a tag fncall.severity=strict|soft and fncall.sample_rate. dashboards materialize metrics from both.
sasha (platform): metric naming: fncall.rejects.count and fncall.softfails.sampled.count, labels: route, schema, variant, reject_reason. UI will surface strict as raw rate and soft as sampled-smoothed.
noah (product): can we have a canary plan? I suggest 10% of routes for 48h, compare pre/post strict counts. automatic rollback if strict counts spike >5% or alert latency regresses.
li (eng-telemetry): we'll add a time-to-alert histogram (first_strict_reject -> alert_fire) to ensure we don't make detection slower.
sasha (platform): ops-bot: create a draft alert for strict rejects (e.g., fncall.rejects.rate by route > threshold for 5m).
ops-bot: created draft alert PLAT-3180. preview: fncall.rejects.rate > 0.4% for 5m by route.
maya (privacy): also require origin: system vs customer. system-synth examples ok to show; customer examples require explicit customer consent before text is displayed. UI default hides raw text until consent.
sasha (platform): we'll include origin_tag and redaction_flag on strict payloads. internal tooling will require verification before displaying raw.
li (eng-telemetry): retention/finance question: strict stream will add storage. propose labeling strict events billing_bucket=reject_forensics and set default retention 90d; soft samples TTL 30d. enterprise accounts can opt into extended retention.
noah (product): be careful with billing surprises. default collection should be internal-only; per-customer forensic exports should be gated and possibly billable. product will draft console copy for the toggle and opt-in flow.
sasha (platform): agreed. next: eng-security/priv review. maya, can you sign off on redaction regex + requirement that we never log auth tokens or credentials?
maya (privacy): yes, will run checklist and provide transforms. also require scrub of long user content > 2k chars.
li (eng-telemetry): detection rule: current validator returns VALID / SOFT_FAIL / STRICT_FAIL. mapping: STRICT_FAIL => strict. additionally, if SOFT_FAIL.score < 0.15, escalate to strict for alerting. sound ok?
sasha (platform): yep. that avoids missing low-confidence soft fails that are effectively hard regressions.
noah (product): last UX ask: annotate dashboard with recent deploys and schema edits. last time a schema change caused a spike and it was hard to correlate.
sasha (platform): will add deploy_id/git_sha to strict events and overlay deploy markers on charts.
li (eng-telemetry): sampling determinism: use deterministic hash(route_id + day) so examples are reproducible for follow-ups.
sasha (platform): rollout plan from telemetry: 1) infra topics + sampler 2) API instrumentation 3) storage + retention policy 4) dashboard UI changes 5) 10% canary x48h 6) full rollout. estimate 2 sprints.
li (eng-telemetry): small pseudo-config for sampler:
```
topic: fncall.fails.soft.sampled
sample_key: hash(route_id || date)
sample_rate: 0.02
retain_days: 30
```
sasha (platform): great. action items: li opens infra PR, maya posts redaction rules, ops-bot files canary ticket, noah drafts console wording including cost note. I'll write rollout doc and share in channel tomorrow.
noah (product): thanks. can we also show an estimated delta in telemetry cost on the rollout page? I'll coordinate with finance.
ops-bot: created ticket FIN-3301 "fncall telemetry cost estimate" and assigned to finance-ops.
sasha (platform): perfect. dropping the rollout doc link here when ready. cheers everyone :thumbsup:
